title: Hollow Worm Sub
description: A sub-register FM bass voice that crawls in the basement octaves, its FM index breathing wide open while a pitch envelope bends each note like a creature swallowing. Over 32 cycles the harmonicity steps and a band-pass sweep hollows the tone out, so the loop feels like an organism slowly inhaling and exhaling.
code:
setcpm(116/4)
stack(
  note("<c1 c1 eb1 <g0 ab0>>*2").s("sine")
    .fm(sine.slow(16).range(1.5, 11)).fmh("<0.5 1 1.5 2>/8")
    .penv("<7 -5 12 -9>/4").pattack(0.004).pdecay(sine.slow(13).range(0.06, 0.3))
    .vib("<3 5 7>/8").vibmod(sine.slow(23).range(0.1, 0.9))
    .bpf(sine.slow(32).range(120, 1800)).resonance(14).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(2).lpattack(0.006).lpdecay(0.2)
    .attack(0.005).decay(0.25).sustain(0.55).release(0.08)
    .shape(sine.slow(19).range(0.1, 0.4)).coarse("<1 1 2>/12")
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.3, 0.7))
    .sometimesBy(0.12, x => x.speed(-1))
    .off(1/8, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.22).delay("0.4:0.375:0.6"))
    .room(0.4).gain(0.85)
)
